english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a physical object bounds or springs back after impact.

exampleSentences.english: The ball will rebound after hitting the wall.
exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 bo1 zong6 dou3 coeng4 zau6 wui5 faan2 daan6

english.note: Use 反彈 when something rebounds after impact, including a ball off a wall or an aircraft bouncing on landing.

exampleSentences.english: The ball did bounce back after hitting the wall.
exampleSentences.traditional: 個波撞到牆之後反彈返嚟。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go3 bo1 zong6 dou3 coeng4 zi1 hau6 faan2 daan6 faan1 lei4
